description: This Java class defines the entity 'LoanAmortizationAllocationMapping' which models the mapping between base loan transactions and their amortization allocations within a loan management system. It contains fields for loan IDs, transaction IDs, date, amortization type, and amount, as well as persistence annotations for mapping to a database table.
